_comment: DRISHTI Prompt 24 - resolved environment-specific deploy config (placeholders from gpu-worker-infra.json filled at deploy time). No secrets/credentials. Account id appears in ARNs (standard, not a credential).
instance_gpu: 1x NVIDIA T4 (Turing sm_75), 16 GB VRAM, 8 vCPU, 32 GB RAM
instance_type_rationale: Descriptor default ml.g5.xlarge has endpoint quota=0 in this account; ml.g4dn.2xlarge for endpoint usage quota=1.0 is available now (no quota increase). T4 runs the real TabFM + TimesFM 2.5-200m within 16 GB.

ecr.encryption_note: ECR AES256 (AWS-managed) at rest; the KMS CMK is used for the S3 model/async-IO artifacts where the descriptor emphasises KMS.
ecr.image_note: 0.2.3 fixes the TabFM licence marker (weights are TabFM Non-Commercial License v1.0, not Apache-2.0). 0.2.2 fixed serve quoting; 0.2.1 added serve; 0.2.0 lacked serve. Built by AWS CodeBuild in-cloud.

s3.lifecycle: async-io/ objects expire after 7 days; noncurrent after 3; abort incomplete MPU after 2

iam.scope: ECR pull (worker repo only), S3 get/put/list (model-plane bucket only), KMS decrypt/generateDataKey (CMK only), SageMaker CloudWatch logs, PutMetricData

sagemaker._endpoint_rename_note: 0.2.0/0.2.1 attempts left a stuck-Creating endpoint 'drishti-gpu-async' (image bugs); to avoid a long wait for it to fail+delete, 0.2.2 deploys under 'drishti-gpu-async2'. The old one is deleted once terminal.
